Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 9985/2023 Ganesh S/o Morechand, Aged About 21 Years, R/o Borakhandi Ps Anandpuri Dist.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Banswar Raj.

(Presently Lodged In Jail Banswara)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through P.P.
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Raghuveer Singh Bhati.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Kumar, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/08/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.132/2022, registered at Police Station Ambapura, District Banswara, for offences under Sections 363, 366, 344, 376(2)(n) & 376(3) IPC and Section 5()/6 of the POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prosecutrix voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner and is living with him out of her free will and volition.
Attention of the Court was drawn towards an affidavit sworn by prosecutrix stating inter alia that she was neither abducted nor subjected to sexual assault by the present petitioner.
It was brought to the notice of this Court that the prosecutrix has now attained majority and has also given birth to a child.

[CRLMB-9985/2023] Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that in view of the fact that the prosecutrix who has already attained majority and is living with the present petitioner happily, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the petitioner behind the bars for an indefinite period.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival Ganesh vs State Of Rajasthan on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176131889/
1 submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, so also the fact that the date of birth of the prosecutrix is 06.06.2005 and she has submitted an affidavit before this Court stating that she is living with the present petitioner out of her free will and volition and has denied any allegation of sexual assault against the present petitioner, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Ganesh S/o Morechand arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.132/2022,
registered at Police Station Ambapura, District Banswara, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 669-Prashant/-
